title: A cheque deposit followed closely by an outbound wire of similar size
definition: A cheque or other payable instrument deposited and followed within a short window by an outbound electronic transfer of a similar amount, where the account's ordinary activity does not involve that sequence. The indicator measures the sequence and its timing; it does not establish the purpose of either leg.
evidence_to_cite: the deposit record and the outbound transfer record
the account's ordinary activity pattern, over a stated period
the stated purpose of the outbound transfer, where a payment instruction exists
benign_explanations: A business that takes a cheque for a sale and settles the supplier the same week.
A customer paying a deposit on a property or a vehicle.
An agent who receives a cheque and remits the proceeds, as their business model states.
A payment processor settling a merchant's takings the day after the deposit.

sources.citation: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, funds transfer and reporting guidance, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
